name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
description: A woody, aromatic fragrance for men that expresses freedom and sensuality. An ode to masculine elegance with fresh citrus opening, warm heart of incense and a deep sandalwood base.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
description: A radically fresh fragrance inspired by wide-open spaces. Powerful freshness with bergamot from Calabria, woody warmth from Ambroxan and Madagascar pepper. Bold, noble, wild.

name: Black Orchid Eau de Parfum
description: A luxurious and sensual fragrance with rich dark accords. Black orchid, dark chocolate, black truffle and bergamot create a darkly seductive signature. A lavish blend of black orchids and exotic woods.

name: Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum
description: A rich oriental fragrance evoking the gentleman's club. Warm tobacco leaf and vanilla combine with aromatic spices for a deeply cozy, sensual scent. Rich, warming, comforting.

name: Oud Wood Eau de Parfum
description: Rare oud wood is blended with smoky rosewood, cardamom, sandalwood, vetiver and amber. An exotic and sensual wood fragrance with unexpected warmth and depth. Intense and mysterious.

name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne
description: Earthy ambrette and woody sage are beautifully lifted by sea salt. A wild and effortless scent inspired by windswept cliffs meeting the ocean. Fresh, marine, and lightly salty.

name: Peony & Blush Suede Cologne
description: An English floral with unexpected suede warmth. Peony, red apple and rose are anchored by soft suede. Romantic yet modern, delicate yet bold. A feminine signature that is utterly unique.

name: Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne
description: A surprisingly sensuous interpretation of an English herb garden. Peppery basil and aromatic white thyme shift mysteriously against the freshness of lime and mandarin. Light, clean, vibrant.

name: Gypsy Water Eau de Parfum
description: Inspired by the fascination of gypsy folklore. Fresh bergamot, juniper berries and pine needles open into a heart of incense, orris and sandalwood. A free-spirited woody fragrance.

name: Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum
description: Inspired by the resilience of a rare desert flower surviving in the Mojave. Ambrette and magnolia bloom over sandalwood and the ghost flower accord. Airy, woody, floral, completely unique.

name: Bal d'Afrique Eau de Parfum
description: A celebration of Africa, inspired by a bohemian journey. Bergamot and African marigold open into cedar, violet and neroli, resting on musky vetiver and white musk. Vibrant, warm, earthy.

name: Replica Beach Walk Eau de Toilette
description: The scent of a perfect summer afternoon on the French Riviera. Bergamot, sea notes and coconut milk create a bright, carefree and sunny fragrance. Marine, fresh, and beautifully warm.

name: Replica Jazz Club Eau de Toilette
description: The scent of a New York jazz club at night. Pink pepper, neroli and lemon open into tobacco leaf, vetiver and vanilla. A smooth, warm and sensual evening fragrance with character.

name: Replica Flower Market Eau de Toilette
description: The scent of a Parisian flower market on a fresh morning. Lilac, rose and peony are lifted by green leaf accord and soft musk. A vibrant, fresh and luminous floral fragrance.

name: Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette
description: The soft, powdery scent of clean linen on a lazy Sunday. Iris, white musk and peony create an airy and light fragrance. Clean, gentle, powdery and deeply comforting.

name: Black Opium Eau de Parfum
description: A rock'n'roll fragrance with a sweet, addictive character. Coffee, vanilla and white flowers create an intense, feminine and sensual signature. Energizing and mysterious.

name: Libre Eau de Parfum
description: A fragrance of freedom and femininity. Lavender from Provence and Moroccan orange blossom are blended with Madagascar vanilla. A bold and liberating signature.

name: Mon Paris Eau de Parfum
description: A fruity floral fragrance inspired by an amorous adventure in Paris. Raspberry, strawberry and white flowers on a base of patchouli and white musk. Playful, sweet, romantic.

name: Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum
description: A dialogue between land and sky. Citrus freshness of orange and grapefruit transitions to woody, mineral depth of vetiver, flint and benzoin. Earthy, powerful, deeply masculine.

name: Un Jardin sur le Nil Eau de Toilette
description: An ode to the banks of the Nile. Green lotus, osmanthus and sycamore fig create a fresh, watery and exotic fragrance. Light, serene and luminous — a garden floating on water.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Intense Eau de Parfum
description: A modern, sensual Oriental fragrance. Vibrant and audacious with bergamot and orange opening, rose and jasmine heart, patchouli and vetiver depth. Bold, free and intensely feminine.

name: N°5 Eau de Parfum
description: The timeless floral aldehyde that changed perfumery forever. Ylang-ylang and neroli open to a floral heart of rose and jasmine over warm sandalwood and vanilla. Iconic, pure feminine.

name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum
description: A floral chypre fragrance — the scent of love. Grasse rose absolute and peony bloom over patchouli and white musk. Fresh, romantic and joyful with a timeless feminine elegance.

name: J'adore Eau de Parfum
description: The luminous floral signature of Dior femininity. Ylang-ylang, Damascus rose and jasmine create a rich, opulent and beautiful scent. Voluptuous, radiant, absolutely feminine.

name: Bloom Eau de Parfum
description: A floral abundance that celebrates the power of nature. Tuberose, jasmine and rangoon creeper create a rich yet pure and natural floral fragrance. Fresh, intense and alive.

name: Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum
description: An explosion of flowers — the antidote to negativity. Freesia, rose, jasmine and patchouli in a warm oriental base. A powerful, sweet and feminine fragrance that blooms on skin.

name: Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum
description: Inspired by the sea and the sky of Pantelleria island. An aquatic freshness of bergamot, marine accord and rosemary leads to woody base. A timeless, masculine aquatic fragrance.

name: Sì Eau de Parfum
description: A modern feminine elegance inspired by the Italian way of living. Blackcurrant, rose and freesia on a warm vanilla and ambroxan base. Sensual, free, strong and feminine.

name: Daisy Eau de Toilette
description: A fresh, youthful and feminine fragrance as joyful as a field of daisies. Violet, jasmine and gardenia over musk and white woods. Pure, innocent and beautifully simple.

name: Her Eau de Parfum
description: A fruity floral fragrance inspired by London's free-spirited modern girl. Vivid red fruits, jasmine and violet create a playful yet sophisticated signature. Fresh, juicy, feminine.

name: La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum
description: Life is beautiful — a universal declaration of happiness. Iris, praline and sweet patchouli create a warm, uplifting and feminine fragrance. Optimistic, radiant, absolutely joyful.

name: Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette
description: A sensual and luminous fragrance like a precious gemstone. Yuzu, pomegranate and peony bloom over lotus and magnolia on a base of amber musk. Fresh, feminine and effortlessly elegant.

name: Good Girl Eau de Parfum
description: An opulent floral oriental with a dual personality — good and bad. Jasmine and tuberose bloom over a seductive base of cocoa, coffee and tonka bean. Daring, addictive, feminine.

name: For Her Eau de Parfum
description: A skin-close musk fragrance, clean and sensual. Rose, peony and musc create a uniquely intimate and personal scent that feels like a second skin. Minimalist, elegant, unforgettable.

name: Aventus Eau de Parfum
description: Inspired by the tumultuous life of Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte. Pineapple, birch and blackcurrant open to rose and jasmine, settling on oakmoss, ambergris and musk. Bold, masculine, legendary.
